name: USDJPY NFP Reaction: Beat vs Miss
description: How does USD/JPY move after NFP releases that beat vs miss expectations? Beat/miss defined as MoM payroll change above/below its trailing 6-month average. Forward returns measured at 1d, 3d, 5d, 10d, 20d horizons. Outputs: grouped bar chart of median returns by horizon and surprise direction, event markers with beat/miss labels, and a stats table with N, median, hit rate, best, and worst per group.
source:
# USDJPY NFP Reaction: Beat vs Miss
# Beat = MoM payroll change > trailing 6-month avg, Miss = below
# Forward returns: 1d, 3d, 5d, 10d, 20d after NFP announcement

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
ts = index().value

# --- NFP Calendar (exact announcement dates) ---
nfp_cal = economic_calendar(source=CalendarSource.FRED, release_id=50)()
is_nfp = nfp_cal.is_released

# --- PAYEMS data for surprise classification ---
nfp_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='PAYEMS')()
nfp_val = ffill(nfp_raw.result)

# MoM change in payrolls (thousands) — computed on observation dates
had_nfp_obs = is_valid(nfp_raw.result)
mom_change = nfp_raw.result - valuewhen(occurrence=1)(had_nfp_obs, nfp_raw.result)

# Trailing 6-month average of MoM changes (S34 sparse MA pattern)
chg_1 = valuewhen(occurrence=1)(had_nfp_obs, mom_change)
chg_2 = valuewhen(occurrence=2)(had_nfp_obs, mom_change)
chg_3 = valuewhen(occurrence=3)(had_nfp_obs, mom_change)
chg_4 = valuewhen(occurrence=4)(had_nfp_obs, mom_change)
chg_5 = valuewhen(occurrence=5)(had_nfp_obs, mom_change)
trailing_6m_avg = (mom_change + chg_1 + chg_2 + chg_3 + chg_4 + chg_5) / 6

# ffill both so they're available on announcement dates
mom_change_ff = ffill(mom_change)
trailing_avg_ff = ffill(trailing_6m_avg)

# Classify on NFP announcement day: beat vs miss
is_beat = is_nfp and is_valid(mom_change_ff) and mom_change_ff > trailing_avg_ff
is_miss = is_nfp and is_valid(mom_change_ff) and mom_change_ff <= trailing_avg_ff

# --- Forward Returns (on USDJPY price) ---
fwd_1d = forward_returns(period=1)(close)
fwd_3d = forward_returns(period=3)(close)
fwd_5d = forward_returns(period=5)(close)
fwd_10d = forward_returns(period=10)(close)
fwd_20d = forward_returns(period=20)(close)

# --- Filter by beat/miss ---
beat_1d = where(is_beat, fwd_1d)
beat_3d = where(is_beat, fwd_3d)
beat_5d = where(is_beat, fwd_5d)
beat_10d = where(is_beat, fwd_10d)
beat_20d = where(is_beat, fwd_20d)

miss_1d = where(is_miss, fwd_1d)
miss_3d = where(is_miss, fwd_3d)
miss_5d = where(is_miss, fwd_5d)
miss_10d = where(is_miss, fwd_10d)
miss_20d = where(is_miss, fwd_20d)

# --- Hit rates (% positive USDJPY return = USD strengthened) ---
beat_hit_1d = 1.0 if (is_valid(beat_1d) and beat_1d > 0) else 0.0
beat_hit_3d = 1.0 if (is_valid(beat_3d) and beat_3d > 0) else 0.0
beat_hit_5d = 1.0 if (is_valid(beat_5d) and beat_5d > 0) else 0.0
beat_hit_10d = 1.0 if (is_valid(beat_10d) and beat_10d > 0) else 0.0
beat_hit_20d = 1.0 if (is_valid(beat_20d) and beat_20d > 0) else 0.0

miss_hit_1d = 1.0 if (is_valid(miss_1d) and miss_1d > 0) else 0.0
miss_hit_3d = 1.0 if (is_valid(miss_3d) and miss_3d > 0) else 0.0
miss_hit_5d = 1.0 if (is_valid(miss_5d) and miss_5d > 0) else 0.0
miss_hit_10d = 1.0 if (is_valid(miss_10d) and miss_10d > 0) else 0.0
miss_hit_20d = 1.0 if (is_valid(miss_20d) and miss_20d > 0) else 0.0

# --- PUNCHLINE: Median forward returns by horizon, Beat vs Miss ---
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.series,
    agg=AggregationType.Median,
    title='NFP Beat vs Miss: How Does USDJPY React?',
    category='NFP Beat vs Miss',
    y_axis_label='Median Return',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+1d', color=Color.Blue, stack='Beat'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+3d', color=Color.Blue, stack='Beat'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+5d', color=Color.Blue, stack='Beat'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+10d', color=Color.Blue, stack='Beat'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+20d', color=Color.Blue, stack='Beat'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+1d', color=Color.Slate, stack='Miss'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+3d', color=Color.Slate, stack='Miss'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+5d', color=Color.Slate, stack='Miss'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+10d', color=Color.Slate, stack='Miss'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+20d', color=Color.Slate, stack='Miss')
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=1
)(beat_1d, beat_3d, beat_5d, beat_10d, beat_20d, miss_1d, miss_3d, miss_5d, miss_10d, miss_20d)

# --- CONTEXT: USDJPY price line ---
xy_lines(
    title='USDJPY with NFP Release Dates',
    category='NFP Beat vs Miss',
    y_axis_label='USDJPY',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='USDJPY', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    order=2
)(x_values=ts, y_values=close)

# --- REFERENCE: Stats table (10 rows x 5 cols) ---
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='NFP Beat vs Miss',
    order=3,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Post-NFP Return Statistics: Beat vs Miss',
        row_size=10,
        col_size=5,
        row_headers=['Beat +1d', 'Beat +3d', 'Beat +5d', 'Beat +10d', 'Beat +20d',
                     'Miss +1d', 'Miss +3d', 'Miss +5d', 'Miss +10d', 'Miss +20d'],
        col_headers=['N', 'Median', 'Hit Rate', 'Best', 'Worst'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),

            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),

            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),

            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),

            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),

            ColumnSpec(grid_row=5, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=5, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=5, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=5, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=5, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),

            ColumnSpec(grid_row=6, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=6, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=6, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=6, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=6, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),

            ColumnSpec(grid_row=7, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=7, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=7, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=7, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=7, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),

            ColumnSpec(grid_row=8, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=8, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=8, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=8, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=8, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),

            ColumnSpec(grid_row=9, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=9, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=9, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=9, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=9, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    )
)(beat_1d, beat_1d, beat_hit_1d, beat_1d, beat_1d,
  beat_3d, beat_3d, beat_hit_3d, beat_3d, beat_3d,
  beat_5d, beat_5d, beat_hit_5d, beat_5d, beat_5d,
  beat_10d, beat_10d, beat_hit_10d, beat_10d, beat_10d,
  beat_20d, beat_20d, beat_hit_20d, beat_20d, beat_20d,
  miss_1d, miss_1d, miss_hit_1d, miss_1d, miss_1d,
  miss_3d, miss_3d, miss_hit_3d, miss_3d, miss_3d,
  miss_5d, miss_5d, miss_hit_5d, miss_5d, miss_5d,
  miss_10d, miss_10d, miss_hit_10d, miss_10d, miss_10d,
  miss_20d, miss_20d, miss_hit_20d, miss_20d, miss_20d)

# --- EVENT MARKERS: NFP releases with beat/miss label ---
surprise_label = conditional_select(is_beat, "Beat", is_miss, "Miss", "N/A")
direction_label = conditional_select(
    is_nfp and is_valid(fwd_1d) and fwd_1d > 0, "USD Strong",
    is_nfp and is_valid(fwd_1d) and fwd_1d < 0, "USD Weak",
    "Flat"
)
nfp_mom_on_release = where(is_nfp, mom_change_ff)

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='NFP Release',
        icon=Icon.ZapIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Surprise', type=CardRenderType.TextFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title='Direction', type=CardRenderType.TextFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.SecondaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title='+1d Return', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='MoM Change (K)', dp=0, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='+20d Return', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(title='USDJPY', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(surprise_label, direction_label, fwd_1d, nfp_mom_on_release, fwd_20d, close, is_nfp)
